children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall design (to the extent that design forms part of the Sub Contract Works), execute and complete the Sub-Contract Works in accordance with the Sub Contract Documents and to the reasonable satisfaction of LLE and in conformity with the reasonable directions and requirements of LLE in accordance with the Main Contract programme which may be changed from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b:Specialist's Obligations}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will carry out the Sub Contract Works with due regard for the provisions of the Main Contract and shall ensure that the manner in which the Specialist carries out the Sub Contract Works shall not cause LLE to be in breach of any of LLE's obligations under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall, upon request, be provided with a copy of the documents comprising the Main Contract (the Contract Documents) in so far as these relate to the Sub-Contract Works. The Specialist however is not entitled to particulars relating to LLE's prices and these may be deleted from any documents which are provided to the Specialist.  The Specialist will not act, or fail to act, in any manner which causes a breach of the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist is deemed to be aware of the provisions of the Main Contract relating to the obligation to give notice of events or circumstances which may give rise to an entitlement to additional payment and/or extension of  time and/or to any other entitlement under the Main Contract and will deliver to LLE any notice, information or other requirement relating to the Sub-Contract Works, which LLE is entitled to, or is required to, furnish to the Architect/Engineer, in sufficient time and detail as to enable LLE to meet the time requirements and other obligations of the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Parties acknowledge that this Sub-Contract constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties relating to the subject matter of this Sub-Contract and supersedes all prior representations, communications, negotiations and agreements concerning the subject matter of this Sub-Contract.

If LLE or  Specialist finds any such discrepancy it shall immediately give the other party written notice specifying such discrepancy.

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: {b:Safety, Health and Welfare Statutory Requirements}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will comply with all current health and safety legislation and with the current Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations and will provide to LLE all documents required for the Safety File (as defined in the current Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations) relevant to the Sub-Contract Works in sufficient time as to enable LLE meet its obligations under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist (without limiting its other obligations) shall ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the Sub-Contract Works:

children.name: text
children: Are designed (to the extent that they are designed by the Specialist or the Specialist's Personnel) to be safe and are capable of being constructed safely and without risk to health and can be maintained safely and without risk to health during use and

children.name: text
children: are constructed in a safe manner; and

children.name: text
children: Not used.

children.name: text
children: comply in all respects, as appropriate, with the relevant statutory provisions.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist represents and warrants to LLE that the Specialist is, and will be, while performing this Sub-Contract, a competent person for the purpose of ensuring, so far as is reasonably practicable, that the Sub-Contract Works are as stated in sub-clause 2.3.2.

children.name: text
children: {b:Confidentiality}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall keep in strict confidence the Sub-Contract, all technical or commercial know-how, all specifications, drawings, data, inventions, processes or initiatives which are of a confidential nature and have been disclosed by LLE or its agents and any other confidential information concerning LLE's business or its products which the Specialist may obtain. The Specialist shall restrict disclosure of such confidential information to such of its employees, agents or  Specialists as need to know the same for the purpose of discharging the Specialist's obligations to LLE and shall ensure that such employees, agents or  Specialists are subject to no lesser obligations of confidentially as bind the Specialist in respect of LLE's confidential information. Unless required by law, the Specialist shall not create, publish or release any announcements, press releases, articles, posts on any social media or any other form of publicity whatsoever in relation to the Sub-Contract, the Main Contract Works, the Contractor or its customer or LLE, without LLE's prior written approval. No such communications or materials shall be published or released until it has been pre­ approved in its final form by LLE in writing. This Clause 2.4 shall survive the termination of the Sub-Contract irrespective of the reason for termination.

children.name: text
children: {b:Data Protection}

children.name: text
children: In addition to the Parties obligations under any disclosure/nondisclosure agreements, where under this Sub-Contract LLE discloses information relating to an identified or identifiable individual, partnership, corporation or other entity ('Personal Data') the Specialist will apply appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect Personal Data against destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure or access, and against all other unlawful forms of processing. The Specialist represents and warrants: (i) that it will comply with applicable data protection laws and regulations (including any requirement for notification to, or registration with, country data protection authorities), and (ii) that it will only access, use, manage, disclose to third parties, transfer overseas or otherwise process Personal Data in accordance with LLE's instructions. LLE generally instructs the Specialist to process Personal Data to the extent necessary to perform the Sub-Contract. The Specialist shall promptly assist LLE in responding to requests to allow access to, correct, block, suppress or delete any Personal Data, including providing LLE with a copy of all relevant Personal Data in tangible form.  The Specialist will not transfer any Personal Data out of any country having data protection laws and/or regulations restricting transfers of Personal Data unless that transfer is unavoidable in Agreement for the Specialist to perform its obligations under the Sub-Contract, or where LLE consents to the transfer in writing. LLE may, upon reasonable notice, audit and verify Specialist’s compliance with the provisions of this clause. On termination of the Sub-Contract the Specialist shall, at LLE's request, promptly return or erase all Personal Data stored in its internal systems

children: {b:Loss, Damage and Injury}

children.name: text
children: {b: Specialist’s Indemnities}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will indemnify and save harmless LLE against and from any loss or expense incurred by LLE due to any failure on the part of the Specialist to observe the terms of this Sub-Contract or the terms of the Main Contract insofar as they apply to this Sub-Contract, including, where applicable, any liquidated damages) LLE is, or may be, obliged to pay to the Contractor as a result of such failure.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will indemnify and save harmless LLE and the Contractor in relation to any damage to the Works or to any property of LLE or of the Contractor arising from or in the course of the Specialist’s performance or non-performance of the Sub-Contract. The Specialist’s liability under this sub-clause will not apply to the extent that the loss or damage arises from circumstances to which the Contactor’s indemnity under the Main Contract applies or to the extent that the same was caused by the negligence or default of LLE. Nor will the Specialist be liable for such loss and damage to the extent that it is occasioned by a risk which is that of the Contractor under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will indemnify and save harmless LLE and the Contractor in respect of any loss arising as a result of:

children.name: text
children: Death, injury or illness of any person; and

children.name: text
children: Loss, destruction of or damage to any physical property; and

children.name: text
children: Obstruction, loss of amenities, nuisance, trespass, stoppage of traffic and infringement of light, other easement or quasi easement; arising from or in the course of the performance or non-performance of the Sub-Contract. The Specialist’s indemnity in relation to the death, injury or illness of Specialist’s Personnel will apply regardless of whether the death, illness, or injury was caused wholly or in part by the negligence of any third party including LLE, LLE’s Personnel or the Contractor or the Contractor’s Personnel. Subject to the foregoing the Specialist will not be liable to indemnify LLE or the Contractor in respect of the risks identified in sub-clauses 3.1.4.1, .2 or .3 above to the extent that the loss is caused by the negligence of LLE or the Contractor or as a result of risks in relation to which the Contractor has indemnified LLE under the Main Contract or the risks assumed by the Contractor thereunder.

children.name: text
children: {b:Obligation to Repair}

children.name: text
children: In case of any loss or damage to the Sub-Contract Works, including any Sub-Contract Works Items, due to any event which is the responsibility, or at the risk, of the Specialist, including any loss or damage due to defective design by the Specialist, the Specialist shall proceed with due diligence to rectify such loss or damage at its own expense.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insurance of the Works and Specialist's Things}

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise advised, the Contractor shall for the benefit of LLE and its Specialists keep in force in accordance with the requirements of the Main Contract a policy of insurance covering the Works and Works Items (including the Sub-Contract Works and Sub-Contract Works Items) which as regards loss or damage shall be at the sole risk of LLE while covered by the said insurance policy.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall take out insurance on terms and with an insurer approved by LLE (such approval not to be unreasonably withheld) of the Specialist's Things against destruction, loss, and damage to their full reinstatement value.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall be deemed to have knowledge of all terms and conditions in LLE’s policy of insurance covering the Works and the Specialist shall be entitled to inspect the said policy upon reasonable notice. The Specialist shall observe and comply with the conditions contained in LLE’s policy of insurance covering the Works in so far as compliance is within the control of the Specialist. The Specialist will indemnify LLE in relation to any act or omission on the Specialist’s part which causes LLE’s said policy to become invalid or ineffective in whole or in part.

children.name: text
children: {b:Public Liability and Employer's Liability Insurance}

children.name: text
children: Before commencing the Sub-Contract Works, the Specialist shall take out with an insurer approved by LLE (such approval not to be unreasonably withheld) Public Liability and Employer's Liability policies of insurance as provided herein. The Specialist will maintain such insurance until the end of the Defects Liability Period.

children.name: text
children: The minimum indemnity limits of these policies shall be the sums stated in the Pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes or, if no sums are so stated, shall be those sums stated in the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The excesses in the Specialist's policies of insurance shall not exceed the sums stated in Pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes or, if no sums are so stated, shall not exceed the sums stated in the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: The said policies shall cover the Specialist's liability under statute and at common law and its liability to indemnify LLE under clause 3.1.3 of this Sub-Contract, except damage to the Works and Works Items which is covered by the insurance policy required to be effected by LLE.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist’s public liability policy shall be issued in the joint names of the Specialist, LLE and the Contractor and will contain cross liability clauses such that the policy shall operate as if a separate policy had been issued to each. If under the Main Contract LLE’s public liability insurance is required to include as joint insured another party named by the Contractor that party will also be a joint insured in the Specialist public liability insurance policy.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist's Employer's Liability policy shall include a provision by which, in the event of any claim in respect of which the Specialist would be entitled to receive indemnity under the policy being made against LLE or the Contractor, the insurer will indemnify LLE and the Contractor against such claims and any costs, charges, and expenses in respect thereof.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist may only include in its policies under this clause the exclusions permitted by the Main Contract in relation to the insurances taken out by LLE in so far as the same apply, mutatis mutandis, to the Specialist and/or to the Sub-Contract Work.

children.name: text
children: {b:Professional Indemnity Insurance}

children.name: text
children: If the Pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes state that professional indemnity insurance is required in relationto  the design of the Sub-Contract Works by the Specialist, the Specialist shall arrange such cover for the sum  indicated or agreed to commence with the commencement of the design of the Sub-Contract Works and to  remain effective for a period of at least six years from Substantial Completion (and twelve years, if the Sub  Contract is executed under seal), unless otherwise stated in the Pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes. This  insurance shall include retroactive cover to when the Specialist’s design of the Sub-Contract Works and Sub- Contract Works Items started. If the Specialist is required to provide a Collateral Warranty the minimum indemnity limit and maximum excess professional indemnity insurance requirements in relation thereto are  deemed not to exceed those stated in the Pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes

children.name: text
children: {b:Evidence of Insurance Cover}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall provide written confirmation to the reasonable satisfaction of LLE of the existence of the insurance policies as required under this Sub-Contract and that the premium for each policy has been paid. The Specialist shall obtain written confirmation from its insurers that the said insurers will notify LLE in the event  of any amendment or cancellation of the said insurance policies (including the amount of any excess deductible  therein contained).

children: Instructions of LLE may vary the Sub-Contract Works including, without limitation, by adding to, omitting, and changing the Sub-Contract Works and/or by imposing, removing, and changing restrictions on how they are to be executed.

children.name: text
children: Instructions by LLE shall be given in writing except when there is imminent danger to safety or health or of damage to property, in which case LLE may give oral instructions and shall confirm them in writing as soon as is practicable.

LLE will provide reasonable notice of the Specialist of the dates on which the various elements of the Sub Contract Works are required to be carried out and the Specialist will attend on Site as necessary and as instructed to carry out each element as so instructed. Where LLE’s requirements change, LLE will provide reasonable notice to the Specialist of that change. The Specialist has allowed within the Sub Contract Sum for carrying out the Sub Contract Works in the sequence and at the times instructed by LLE.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall liaise and cooperate with LLE and other sub contractors (including other specialists) of LLE and / or other sub contractors of the Contractor engaged on or in connection with the Works and shall manage and carry out the Sub-Contract Works so that LLE and / or its  other sub contractors and / or other sub contractors of the Contractor are not delayed or disrupted

children: The Specialist shall at all times manage the Sub Contract Works so as to allow reasonable periods of time for the Contractor, the Contractor’s Personnel or LLE to comply with their respective obligations under the Main Contract and under the Sub-Contract

children: The Specialist’s Works shall comply with LLE’s programme at all times and the Specialist’s attendance and sequence of works shall be revised from time to time, as necessary, to do so. LLE shall not revise its programme unreasonably or to an unreasonable extent.

children: The Specialist shall give to LLE with each Payment Claim under clause 11(a) and as a condition precedent to payment, a certificate in respect of the work to which the Payment Claim relates confirming that the Specialist and the Specialist's Personnel have complied in full with this clause all of its legal obligations regarding its employees, in particular in respect of wages and terms of employment.

children.name: text
children: In default of such wages and/or conditions of employment being prescribed as aforesaid, LLE and Specialist as a condition of this Sub-Contract shall pay such wages and/or observe such conditions of employment as may be generally from time to time prevailing in industries or trades of a similar or comparable nature in the districts in which their said respective employees are engaged.

children.name: text
children: {b:Specialists}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall not assign this Sub-Contract nor sub-let the Sub-Contract Works or any portion of the same without the written consent of LLE and, if required by the Main Contract, the Architect/Engineer, provided that the consent of LLE shall not be unreasonably withheld, and that in case of any difference of opinion between LLE and the Architect/Engineer the opinion of the Architect/Engineer shall prevail.

children.name: text
children: {b:Collateral Agreements}

children.name: text
children: If a collateral agreement is required from the Specialist, the Specialist shall provide to LLE a collateral agreement in the form provided by LLE on or before the date of the pre-Appointment Meeting or, if no form is provided, the form of Collateral Warranty published by the Royal Institute of the Architects of Ireland and current at the 'Designated Date'. Any such Collateral Agreement shall be executed by the Specialist on or before the date it is required under the terms of the Main Contract. In the event the Contractor makes any deduction from payments otherwise due to LLE because any such collateral agreement has not been provided by the Specialist, LLE itself will be entitled to withhold payment of the amount so withheld from any sum due to the Specialist until the executed collateral agreement is provided.

children.name: text
children: {b:Removal of Work Persons}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall remove from the site any Specialist Personnel where the Architect/Engineer so directs under the terms of the Main Contract. The Specialist will also remove from the site any Specialist Personnel where LLE so directs.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall not substitute, dismiss or otherwise replace any of the personnel named in the Sub-Contract Particulars without the prior written consent of LLE. At no time shall the roles held by any such named personnel be vacated without suitable replacement or substitute personnel being immediately appointed to such roles. The Specialist shall at all times act so as to ensure that the continuity and progress of the project is not adversely affected.

children.name: text
children: {b:Labour Records}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure that it adheres to LLE's policies as set out in Appendices A and B or otherwise referred to in this Sub-Contract. In particular, the Sub-Specialist shall collate, validate and store all appropriate documentation required to evidence the legal status of all workers on Site including as a minimum, the following:

children.name: text
children: Where required, proof of legal right to work in the jurisdiction (e.g., EU/EEA Passport or valid work permit) as may be mandated under the local laws;

children.name: text
children: Personal income tax reference or the local equivalent thereof;

children.name: text
children: Social Security number or the local equivalent thereof (e.g., National Insurance Number);

children.name: text
children: Where relevant, current EU Health Card;

children.name: text
children: National Identity Card (or local equivalent) where required by the local law;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure that copies of the abovementioned documentation are maintained for all Specialist Personnel on the Site and LLE shall be entitled to audit the Specialist's records in relation to such personnel to verify compliance with this provision.

children.name: text
children: {b:Biometric Access System}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist undertakes that it shall at all times strictly observe the use of any biometric authentication-based access system that is operated by LLE or the Contractor at the Site and shall ensure that all of its personnel at all times utilise this system to log their entry to and exit from the Site. The Specialist shall observe all security and access requirements and procedures applicable to the Site.

children.name: text
children: {b:The Site}

children.name: text
children: {b:Access to the Works}

children.name: text
children: LLE shall make available to the Specialist such access to the Site as is necessary to enable the Specialist to carry out the Sub Contract Works as instructed by LLE under clause 4.3.1. For the avoidance of doubt, LLE shall have no obligation to give the Specialist exclusive possession or exclusive control of any part of the Site, save as expressly provided for otherwise in the Sub-Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: {b:Scaffolding}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist, his employees and workmen in common with all other persons having the like right shall for the purposes of the Sub-Contract Works (but not further or otherwise) be entitled to use any properly labelled scaffolding belonging to or provided by LLE, while it remains so erected upon the site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Attendances}

children.name: text
children: LLE shall provide attendances as identified in Appendix A(i), Pre-appointment Meeting: Attendance and Facilities Matrix. Otherwise the Specialist shall provide everything necessary for the execution of the Sub-Contract Works. LLE will provide all attendances required by this clause in a timely manner so as to enable the Specialist to carry out the Specialist Works in the manner instructed by LLE under clause 4.3.1.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will be responsible for and shall bear the cost (save to the extent that this cost is not recoverable under the Main Contract) of removal from site and disposal of hazardous waste (as defined by Section 4(2)(a) of the Waste Act 1996) arising from the execution of the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Access and Traffic Control}

children.name: text
children: Any special access requirements for works are to be outlined by the Specialist in the Appendix A(i) Pre-appointment Meeting.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall indemnify and hold harmless LLE against all claims under statute or common law for trespass, nuisance or interference with any right of way, light air or water, made by the owners, occupiers, or users of any property adjoining the Site, which are a consequence of the manner in which the Specialist carries out the Sub Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Setting Out the Works}

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the Specialist will set out the Sub- Contract Works in compliance with Appendix A(i) Pre-appointment Meeting.

children.name: text
children: {b:Not used}

children.name: text
children: {b:Site Conditions}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist is deemed to have inspected the Site and the Works in progress and to have fully acquainted itself with the conditions under which the Sub-Contract Works will be carried out. The Specialist shall be responsible for its own interpretation of all drawings, specifications, data and other documentation and information made available to it. No claims will be considered for any costs arising from lack of knowledge, or any misinterpretation or misunderstanding of such conditions or documentation.

children.name: text
children: Unless instructed otherwise, on substantial completion of the Sub Contract Works or of any Section of the Sub Contract Works, the Specialist shall remove from the Site (or section of the Site, as the case may be) the Specialist's Things not required to perform the Specialist's remaining obligations, and leave the Sub Contract Works or Section in an orderly manner. At the end of the Defects Liability Period, the Specialist shall remove from the Site any remaining Specialist's Things.

children.name: text
children: {b:Working Times}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure that the Specialist's Personnel work on the Site only during the working times permitted under the terms of the Main Contract unless:-

children.name: text
children: there is imminent danger to safety or health or of damage to the Works or other property or

children.name: text
children: otherwise agreed with LLE.

children.name: text
children: {b:Right of Access of Specialist and Architect/Engineer}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure that LLE, the Contractor and the Architect/Engineer or his Agent (and all persons duly authorised by them or either of them) shall at all reasonable times have a right of access to any work which is being prepared for, or which will be utilised in, the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Not used}

children.name: text
children: {b:Equipment, Facilities and Utilities}

children.name: text
children: Save as regards any equipment, materials, facilities or utilities described in Appendix A(i) or Appendix A(iv) to be provided by LLE to the Specialist on a free-issued basis or at its own expense, the Specialist itself shall provide all facilities, utilities and supplies necessary for the performance of the Sub-Contract Works at his own expense, including but not limited to fuel, IT, telecoms, site offices, accommodation, storage, containers, temporary plumbing, temporary lighting, temporary power, welfare facilities, scaffolding, hoisting facilities and craneage. All such facilities, utilities and supplies shall be subject to the approval of LLE.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality, Testing and Defects}

children.name: text
children: {b:Standards of Workmanship and Works Items}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure:-

children.name: text
children: that the Sub-Contract Works are designed (to the extent that this is the Specialist's responsibility), executed and completed: in accordance with all the requirements in, and reasonably inferred from, the Sub-Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: That the Sub Contract Works are executed and completed in a proper and workmanlike manner and using good industry practice.

children.name: text
children: that all Sub-Contract Works Items (whether or not the Specialist is required to select them) comply with the Sub-Contract and the Legal Requirements and are new and of good quality (unless the Sub-Contract provides otherwise).

children.name: text
children: That all materials and goods that are Sub-Contract Works Items shall when completed, be free from Defects and shall comply in all aspects with the standards, specifications, criteria as described in the Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality Assurance}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall establish and implement quality assurance procedures as required by the Main Contract in so far as they relate to the Sub-Contract Works, including procedures for establishing quality assurance systems for itself and any other specialists or sub contractors. The quality assurance procedures shall be reflected in appropriate quality plans submitted to LLE. The Specialist shall give to LLE copies of all reports prepared in accordance with the Specialist quality assurance procedures. The Architect/Engineer or LLE may monitor, spot check and audit the Specialist’s quality assurance procedures and the Specialist will cooperate with the Architect/Engineer and with LLE in the conduct of any such spot check.

children.name: text
children: {b:Inspection and Tests}

children.name: text
children: Where applicable, the Specialist shall documentation and inspections in line with LLE's Inspection and Test Plan (ITP).

children.name: text
children: Where applicable, the Specialist shall be defined as the fabricator in terms of PED compliance.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall ensure all relevant documentation is both provided to LLE and uploaded to the applicable project CDE (EIDA or alternative as selected by the client).

children.name: text
children: Where applicable, the Specialist shall undertake pressure testing on all installed works in line with the   Specialists agreed ITP and sequence. The agreed pressure testing may be undertaken both off-site prior to delivery and/or on site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Defects}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall within a reasonable time of receipt of a written notice from LLE make good all defects, shrinkages or other faults in the Sub-Contract Works which are due to materials or workmanship which are not in accordance with the Main Contract or the Sub Contract.

children.name: text
children: If LLE specifies that remediation of the damage or Defect is urgent in nature, the Specialist shall take immediate action to address the Defect. The Specialist shall at its own cost rectify all such Defects or damage, unless (and only to the extent that) such Defect or damage is due or caused by any omission, default or negligence of LLE, in which event the Specialist shall be entitled to notify LLE in accordance with Condition 9.1 Notification and Procedure.

children.name: text
children: If any portion of the Sub-Contract Works or section thereof is repaired or replaced after the Sub-Contract Works has been taken over, then the Defects Liability Period shall re-commence for that item of plant or equipment, or section or portion of the Sub­ Contract Works (as the case may be) from the date that such repair or replacement is completed. The Defects Liability Period shall be further extended for a period equivalent to the period for which the Sub-Contract Works, a section thereof or a major item of plant or equipment (as the case may be) cannot be used for the purposes for which they are intended, by reason of any Defect or damage caused by such Defect (as referred to in Clauses 7.5.1 and 7.5.2  below).

children.name: text
children: If the Specialist fails to rectify the damage or Defect in accordance with the notification given pursuant to Clauses 7.4.1 and 7.4.2 above, then LLE may appoint others to rectify the damage or Defect, and the Specialist shall allow or pay to LLE all costs incurred by reason of such rectification.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist's warranties wherever contained in this Sub-Contract shall be in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other warranties and remedies available to LLE under the relevant laws as they relate to defects, faults or defective work and nothing contained in this Clause shall be construed to establish a period of limitation with respect to other obligations which the Specialist might have under the Sub-Contract or at law, or to limit any other warranties required by the Sub-Contract Documents or at law.

children.name: text
children: {b:Defects Liability Period}

children.name: text
children: The Defect Liability Period is as stated in the Sub-Contract Particulars or, if none is stated, for a period of 12 months from the date of Substantial Completion

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall, within a reasonable time, complete any outstanding works and rectify any Defects brought to his attention by LLE at any time during the course of the Sub Contract Works and up to twenty working days after the expiration of the Defects Liability Period. In so doing, and in conducting any tests after Practical Completion, the Specialist shall cause as little disruption as possible to the Main Contract Works or to any occupants or users of the completed building (as the case may be).

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will indemnify LLE in relation to any cost incurred by LLE in respect of the making good of defects under Clause 7.4.4 above in so far as that cost relates to a Defect in the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: Nothing in this clause nor any exercise or non-exercise by the Contractor, the Architect/Engineer or LLE of their rights under Clause 7.4, nor expiration of the Defects Liability Period, relieves the Specialist of any obligation in relation to any Defect in the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Defects and shrinkages}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall indemnify LLE in respect of any works which LLE is required to carry out as a result of defects, shrinkages or other faults in the Sub-Contract Works due to materials or workmanship not  being  in  accordance  with  this  Sub-Contract  or  to  frost  occurring  before  the  date  of  Practical Completion

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall not be required to pay the cost of any works to make good damage by frost which may appear after Practical Completion unless the Architect shall decide that such damage is due to damage which occurred before Practical Completion

children.name: text
children: {b:Time and Completion}

children.name: text
children: {b:Time and Completion }

children.name: text
children: {b:Commencement Date}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall carry out the Sub-Contract Works as instructed by LLE under Clause 4.3.1. Once the Specialist commences any element of the Sub Contract Works, he shall proceed regularly and diligently with such works (including the production of and the obtaining of all necessary approvals of any drawings, details or calculations for which the Specialist is responsible) and shall complete same within the period reasonably instructed by LLE. The Specialist shall carry out its works so as to ensure that no delay is caused to the Main Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Payment Claims}

children.name: text
children: The parties shall agree and record the Payment Claim Dates which are to apply to this Sub Contract and same shall be recorded in the pre-Appointment Meeting Minutes. If the parties have not agreed the Payment Claim Dates which shall apply (or any of them), the first Payment Claim Date will be deemed to have occurred 30 days after the Commencement Date.

children.name: text
children: Payments will be made in accordance with the provisions of the Construction Contracts Act. However,  it  is  a  condition  precedent  to  LLE's  obligation  to  make  any  payment  that  all  insurances required to be provided by the Specialist are in place (and, where required, have been demonstrated to be in place) prior to the Commencement Date and kept up to date. It is also a condition precedent to LLE's obligation to make any payment that, in respect of that Payment Claim, the Specialist shall have provided the certificate required by clause 5.3.1.

children.name: text
children: {b:Suspension and or Reduction of Scope}

children.name: text
children: LLE may instruct the Specialist to suspend all or part of the Sub-Contract Works if LLE has been instructed to suspend work by the Contractor / Architect/Engineer or LLE has suspended the Works by reason of not being paid by the Contractor. The Specialist shall comply with the instruction and, during the  suspension,  shall  protect,  store  and  secure  the  affected  Sub-Contract  Works  Items  against deterioration, loss and damage and maintain the Sub-Contract Insurances. The Specialist shall take all reasonable steps to mitigate any loss suffered as a consequence of the suspension.

children.name: text
children: Unless LLE has unjustifiably suspended work for non-payment by the Contractor, LLE will have no liability to the Specialist for any loss or delay suffered by the Specialist by reason of any such suspension except where, and to the extent that, LLE recovers payment from the Contractor in relation thereto. If payment is made by the Contractor to LLE in relation to losses sustained by reason of such suspension in relation thereto, the Specialist will be entitled to such proportion thereof as is fair and reasonable in all the circumstances.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any other rights which LLE may possess, if, in the reasonable opinion of LLE, the Specialist fails to make satisfactory progress with the Sub Contract Works, LLE may immediately supplement the Specialist's workforce at any or all levels (including management staff) and/or remove a part of the remaining works from the scope of the Sub-Contract (in which case, LLE may have such part executed by others). In the event that part of the Sub Contract Works is carried out by another sub contractor, the Specialist shall not be entitled to be paid any loss of profit or loss of overhead contribution in respect of the omitted works.

children.name: text
children: The value of the omitted works shall be subtracted from the Sub-Contract Price and value of any sums attributable to the Specialist's site preliminaries and site overhead shall be reduced accordingly. If LLE incurs any loss and/or expense in supplementing the Specialist's workforce and/or in having the Sub-Contract Works carried out by others, then LLE is entitled to recover the amount of such loss and/or expense from the Specialist and may deduct such loss and/or expense from monies otherwise due to the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: If, and to the extent that, LLE has reasonable grounds for believing that it is in the best interests of the Project to do so, LLE shall be entitled, at its absolute discretion, to reduce or otherwise alter the scope of the Sub-Contract Works and/or to engage another specialist to complete any part of the Sub-Contract Works so affected. Any such reduction or other alteration of the Sub-Contract Works shall be implemented via a written instruction pursuant to Clause 9.2.1 this Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Notification of Delay}

children.name: text
children: If the Specialist becomes aware or should have become aware that the Sub-Contract Works are being or are likely to be delayed for any reason, it shall notify LLE of the delay and its cause as soon as practicable but, in any event, in such time to allow LLE, should LLE deem it appropriate to do so, to notify such delay to the Contractor in accordance with the requirements of the Main Contract. The Specialist shall give LLE full details in writing of the delay and its effect on the progress of the Sub-Contract Works without further delay and, in any event, in such time to allow LLE to comply with his obligations under the Main Contract. The Specialist will promptly provide any further information in relation to the delay which either LLE, the Contractor or the Architect/Engineer reasonably requests.

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: {b:Not Used}

children.name: text
children: {b:Completion}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall complete the whole of the Sub-Contract Works as reasonably instructed by LLE under clause 4.3.1.

children.name: text
children: When the Sub-Contract Works, or any section thereof, has achieved Practical Completion as defined in the Sub-Contract Conditions 1.1 Definitions of this Sub-Contract, the Specialist shall issue LLE with a written notice to this effect. On receipt of this notice LLE shall confirm in writing the date on which LLE believes Practical Completion occurred, and if this date is different from that notified by the Specialist, LLE shall provide reasons for his decision. If the Specialist fails to serve a written notice of Practical Completion LLE shall decide, by written notice to the Specialist, the date on which Practical Completion of the Sub-Contract Works was achieved.

children.name: text
children: LLE may direct that the Specialist should complete and hand over parts of the Sub-Contract Works prior to the Completion Date

children.name: text
children: {b:9      CLAIMS AND ADDITIONAL COST}

children.name: text
children: If the Specialist considers that it is entitled to an adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum or that it has any other entitlement under or in relation to the Sub-Contract (including damages for breach of contract on the part of LLE), the Specialist shall, as soon as practicable and in any event in such time as to enable LLE, should he wish to do so, to give notice in accordance with the requirements of the Main Contract, give notice of the claim and the cause of the claim to LLE. The notice must prominently state that it is being given under this sub-clause 10(a)(1).

children.name: text
children: As soon as practicable after giving the notice, and in any event in such time as to enable LLE, should he wish to do so, to give notice in accordance with the requirements of the Main Contract, the Specialist will give to LLE details of the following:

children.name: text
children: a.

children.name: text
children: all relevant facts about the claim;

children.name: text
children: b.

children.name: text
children: a detailed calculation and (so far as practicable) a proposal, based on that calculation, of any adjustment to be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and of the amount of any other entitlement claimed by the Specialist

children.name: text
children: c.

children.name: text
children: Details of the impact, if any, of the cause of the claim on the progress of the Sub Contract Works

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall provide any further information requested by LLE in relation to the event or circumstance.

children.name: text
children: If the Specialist does not give notice and details in accordance with and within the time provided in sub-clause 10(a)(1) and (2) notwithstanding anything else in the Sub-Contract the Specialist shall not be entitled to an increase to the Sub-Contract Sum and LLE shall be released from all liability to the Specialist in relation to the matter, except to the extent that LLE recovers additional payment from the Contractor in respect of the Sub-Contract Works notwithstanding the failure of the Specialist to give such notice, in which case the Specialist will be entitled to corresponding payment valued in accordance with the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: If the cause of the claim has a continuing effect, the Specialist shall update the above information at monthly intervals.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall keep detailed contemporary records to substantiate any aspect of the cause of the claim and its resulting costs. These shall include any records LLE directs the Specialist to keep. The Specialist shall provide the records to LLE if so directed.

children.name: text
children: {b:Adjustments to the Sub-Contract Sum}

children.name: text
children: Adjustments (upward or downward) to the Sub-Contract Sum may arise in respect of additional work, substituted work or omitted work instructed under the Sub Contract.

children.name: text
children: If the additional work, substituted work or omitted work is the same as or similar to work for which there are rates in the Specialist's tender, the adjustment of the Sub-Contract Sum shall be determined using those rates.

children.name: text
children: If the additional work, substituted work or omitted work is not similar to work for which there are rates in the Specialist's tender, the adjustment of the Sub-Contract Sum shall be determined on the basis of the rates in the Specialist's tender when that is reasonable.

children.name: text
children: If the adjustment cannot be determined under the above rules, LLE shall make a fair valuation. The fair valuation will be based on rates for similar work in the locality, if such rates are available.

children.name: text
children: LLE may direct that adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum in respect of additional work or substituted work will be determined on the basis of the additional cost of performing the additional or substituted work, Specialist's instruction or Specialist's Risk Event (as the case may be), as follows:

children.name: text
children: The number of hours worked or to be worked by each category of work person stated in the Appendix Part 2 and engaged on the work, on or off the Site, multiplied in each case by the tendered hourly rate for that category stated in the Appendix Part 2.

children.name: text
children: Not Used

children.name: text
children: Not Used

children.name: text
children: Not Used

children.name: text
children: Where the adjustment to the Sub-Contract Sum arises as a consequence of an event for which LLE is entitled to additional payment under the Main Contract, the method of its determination shall correspond to that being applied under the Main Contract, unless otherwise agreed between LLE and the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: {b:Cost of Disruption}

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Specialist incurs loss solely by reason of (a) an event for which LLE is entitled to additional payment under the Main Contract subject to clause 10(a) hereof or (b) a breach of contract, or variation instructed, by LLE, the Specialist will be entitled to be compensated. For the avoidance of doubt, an instruction by Specialist under clause 4.3.1 regarding the timing or sequencing of the Sub Contract Works shall not entitle the Specialist to additional payment.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Specialist incurs loss by reason of any event other than as provided for in sub-clauses 10(c)(1), the Specialist will have no entitlement to be compensated.

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Specialist is entitled to compensation under sub-clause 10(c)(1), LLE shall make a fair and reasonable assessment of the amount of that compensation.

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: {b:Price Variation}

children.name: text
children: Unless there is an express price fluctuation provision in the Sub Contract, the Sub Contract Sum is fixed and is not subject to adjustment due to price increases, regardless of the magnitude of such increases.

children.name: text
children: {b:Early Warning Process}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall give an early warning by notifying LLE as soon as the Specialist becomes aware of any matter which could increase, or otherwise affect, the Sub-Contract Price, cause delay to the Main Contract Works, or impair the performance of the Sub-Contract Works whilst in use.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist and LLE shall co-operate in making and considering proposals for how the effect of each matter which has been notified as an early warning can be avoided or reduced.

children.name: text
children: Any Specialist's adjustment to the Sub-Contract Price under Clause 9.4 herein shall be valued on the basis that an early warning was given by the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: {b:10      Payment}

children.name: text
children: 10.1  Payment Claims

children.name: text
children: 10.1.1  Not used

children.name: text
children: 10.1.2   Not used

children.name: text
children: 10.1.3  The Specialist shall provide a detailed breakdown of every Payment Claim. All interim payments (where applicable) and the final payment shall be valued on the basis of work properly executed under this Sub-Contract by the Specialist, as more particularly described in clause 10.1.4.

children.name: text
children: 10.1.4  On or before each Payment Claim Date, the Specialist shall submit to LLE a Payment Claim which will include a detailed breakdown of the sum it considers to be the value of the Sub-Contract Works completed up to the date of the Payment Claim (or such other date as shall be agreed between the parties) and indicating the amount it considers payable, which amount will be calculated as follows:-

children.name: text
children: the cumulative value of the Sub-Contract Works properly designed (to the extent that this is the Specialist's responsibility) and executed, valued in accordance with the rates and prices used in the calculation of the Sub-Contract Sum;

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: Plus, if applicable [as provided for below in sub-clause 10.4] the value of unfixed Sub- Contract Works Items, plus

children.name: text
children: Not used.

children.name: text
children: Any other sums claimed by the Specialist in accordance with clause 10 hereof, plus

children.name: text
children: Not used

children.name: text
children: If applicable, any sum payable in relation to price variation under Clause 9.3 hereof,

children.name: text
children: Less any deductions which LLE is entitled to make from any payment to the Specialist under the Sub Contract or otherwise;

children.name: text
children: Less retention calculated in accordance with this clause,

children.name: text
children: Less the total amount of previous payments

children.name: text
children: 10.1.5   If the Specialist wishes the Payment Claim to be treated as a Payment Claim Notice, it shall clearly state that on the face of the Payment Claim and shall state the period, stage of work or activity to which it relates and the subject matter of the Payment Claim.

children.name: text
children: 10.1.6  The Specialist's Payment Claims shall be accompanied by sufficient information in relation to progress of the Sub-Contract Works, together with any other supporting evidence required by the Architect/Engineer (of which LLE will give reasonable notice to the Specialist), to enable LLE and/or the Contractor or the Architect/Engineer to understand the basis for and calculation of all sums claimed and to meet the requirements of the Main Contract in respect of its own Payment Claims.

children.name: text
children: LLE will carry out an assessment of each Payment Claim submitted by the Specialist. If LLE does not agree with any of the sums included against the items listed in 10.1.4, he shall make his own assessment and shall provide a Response to the Specialist setting out his assessment within 21 days of the relevant Payment Claim Date.

children.name: text
children: If the Specialist fails to submit a Payment Claim as and at the time required, LLE may include in its Payment Claim under the Main Contract its own estimate of the sum due in respect of the Sub-Contract Works but shall not be obliged to do so.

children.name: text
children: {b:Deductions}

children.name: text
children: If the Architect/Engineer in any certificate makes a reduction in the quantity of any item which is part of the Sub- Contract Works, LLE may make a corresponding reduction in the sum due to the Specialist, provided the reduction by the Architect/Engineer was not caused by LLE's (or the Contractor's) negligence or breach of contract. LLE shall notify the Specialist of any such deduction within its Response, giving particulars (insofar as same have been provided to LLE) of how the reduction in the sum due has been calculated.

children.name: text
children: If the Architect/Engineer in any certificate makes a deduction in the sum claimed by LLE for the Sub-Contract Works in respect of a variation, LLE may make a corresponding deduction in the sum due to the Specialist. LLE shall notify the Specialist of any such deduction in its Response giving particulars of how the deduction in the sum due has been calculated.

children.name: text
children: LLE may deduct from any sum otherwise due to the Specialist any sum to which LLE is entitled by reason of contra-charge in respect of this Sub- Contract or arising as a consequence of any breach by the Specialist of the terms of this Sub-Contract. LLE shall notify the Specialist of any such deduction [other than deductions covered by Clauses 10.1.1 & 10.1.2 above] in its Response.

children.name: text
children: LLE shall deduct from payments to be made to the Specialist, any sums required to be deducted for tax in accordance with the relevant Statutory Requirements and/or at his discretion, terminate the Sub-Contract with or without notice unless the Sub Specialist produces to his satisfaction a letter from the Inspector of Taxes confirming company or partnership status, or, as the case may be a Tax Exemption Certificate and such periodical renewals thereof as may be necessary to keep it in force for the duration of the Sub-Contract. LLE shall deduct the amount of any levy required by the Construction Industry Training Board (if applicable) and the Specialist will be deemed to have included in his rates for the amount of any such levy.

children.name: text
children: {b:Not used}

children.name: text
children: {b:Payment for Unfixed Works}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist will be entitled to seek payment for unfixed Sub-Contract Work Items if payment for them may be claimed under the Main Contract. Payment will be subject to full compliance by the Specialist with the provisions of the Main Contract and to the title vesting in the Contractor to the Specialist's Unfixed Work Items. The Specialist's entitlement to payment will be dependent upon the Architect/Engineer including for such payment in a certificate for payment issued under the Lead Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Retention}

children.name: text
children: Retention will be deducted from all interim sums due to the Specialist at the rate stated Payment Schedule (Percentage of Certified Value Retained) 20 working days after the issue by the Architect/Engineer of the Certificate of Substantial Completion, half the sum so deducted will be payable to the Specialist and the remaining half (the balance) will be payable 10 working days after the issue by the Architect/Engineer of the Final Certificate. In the event that LLE received the balance of the Retention retained under the Main Contract before the issue of the Final Certificate,  LLE shall pay to the Specialist the remaining retention held under the Sub Contract.

children.name: text
children: If ,and to the extent that, by reason of the Architect/Engineer issuing a Certificate of Substantial Completion for a Section of the Works, LLE becomes entitled to the release of the retention relating to the Sub-Contract Works earlier than would otherwise be the case, LLE shall pay to the Specialist the sum due by way of released retention in respect of the Sub-Contract within 20 working days of the date of the said Certificate.

children.name: text
children: {b:10.6 Final Payment Claim}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall submit to LLE its Final Payment Claim of all sums due under the Sub-Contract, computed in the manner prescribed in sub-clause 10.1.2 hereof, not later than 30 days after the date of the Certificate of Substantial Completion of the Works issued by the Architect/Engineer (which date is to be promptly advised to the Specialist by LLE). The Payment Claim Date for the Final Payment Claim shall be either 30 days after the date of the Certificate of Substantial Completion or the date of the submission of the Final Payment Claim, if earlier. If the Specialist fails to provide its Final Payment Claim in accordance with this clause, LLE may, but is not obliged to, make its own assessment of the final value of the Sub-Contract Works and the final payment due to the Specialist will be that assessment irrespective of whether the Specialist considers that the assessment is incorrect. In the event that the Specialist has failed to provide a Final Payment Claim in accordance with this clause and LLE does not make an estimate of the final value of the sub-contract, LLE shall be released from liability to pay for items not included in previous Payment Claims.

children.name: text
children: Within 30 days of the issue by the Architect/Engineer of the final payment certificate LLE shall pay the Specialist its final payment which shall be the sum due under this Sub-Contract and will include the final payment of retention (if not previously paid), any amount due for additional works instructed after Practical Completion, any amounts which were withheld from the penultimate payment and are now due and deduction of any sums due from the Specialist to LLE. The Final Payment may include other amounts that, according to the sub-contract, are to be paid after Practical Completion of the Works [such as payments for testing after Practical Completion]. LLE shall provide the Specialist with a statement with the final payment showing how the final payment sum has been computed.

children.name: text
children: {b:10.7 Payment following Final Payment Claim}

children.name: text
children: Within 30 days of the applicable Payment Claim Date LLE will pay to the Specialist the amount due in respect of the Final Payment Claim. The provisions relating to Interim Payments in Clause 10.2 in respect of deductions and Clause 10.3 in respect of payment also apply to the payment following the Final Payment Claim.

children.name: text
children: {b:10.8 Not used}

children.name: text
children: {b:Additional Work instructed after Practical Completion}

children.name: text
children: If, after the date of Practical Completion has been certified, LLE instructs the Specialist to carry out additional work, either as a consequence of a variation under the Main Contract or otherwise, in order to obtain payment for it the Specialist will submit a supplemental account not later than one month after the end of the Defects Liability Period. Payment for this additional work will be included in the final payment to the Specialist or, in the event that no other payment is due to the Specialist, payment for the additional work will be not later than 30 days after the date of the Final Certificate issued by the Architect.

children.name: text
children: LLE shall have no liability to the Specialist under or in relation to the Sub-Contract for any matter not detailed in the Specialist's Final Payment Claim except in respect of additional work arising from an instruction from LLE issued after Practical Completion of the Works was certified.

children.name: text
children: {b:Not used}

children: {b:Termination}

children.name: text
children: {b:Termination on Specialist Default}

children.name: text
children: LLE may, without limiting any other rights or remedies, terminate the Specialist's employment under the Sub Contract if any of the following occurs:-

children.name: text
children: The Specialist in breach of contract fails to comply with its obligations under the Sub-Contract and, if the failure can be cured, the Specialist has failed to cure it within 10 days of being requested in writing to do so by LLE;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist abandons or suspends the execution of the Sub-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist fails to provide or maintain the required insurances or performance bond;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist or Specialist's Personnel has committed or caused the Contractor or LLE to commit a serious breach of Legal Requirements;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist or Specialist's Personnel have committed a breach of the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005 or any regulations or code of practice made under it;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist or Specialist's Personnel has not complied with the requirements of clause 5.3 hereof either (a) within 10 days after notice from LLE requiring a failure to be put right or (b) persistently;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist has sub-contracted all or any part of the Sub-Contract Works without the consent in writing of LLE;

children.name: text
children: The Specialist fails to proceed regularly and diligently with the execution of the Sub-Contract Works

children.name: text
children: Any of the following insolvency events:

children.name: text
children: a)

children.name: text
children: a petition is presented to wind up the Specialist and is not dismissed within 10 working days of presentation

children.name: text
children: b)

children.name: text
children: any meeting of creditors or members of the Specialist is convened or held for the purpose of considering a resolution to wind up the Specialist

children.name: text
children: c)

children.name: text
children: any arrangement or composition with or for the benefit of its creditors [including any compromises or arrangements entered into under sections 201 to 204 of the Companies Act 1963] are proposed or entered into by or in respect of the Specialist

children.name: text
children: d)

children.name: text
children: a liquidator, supervisor, receiver, administrator, administrative receiver, trustee or encumbrancer takes possession of or is appointed over the Specialist or any of its assets, or any distress, execution or other process is levied or enforced, and not discharged within 10 working days, on the Specialist or any of its assets

children.name: text
children: e)

children.name: text
children: the Specialist ceases or threatens to cease carrying on business, or is, or is regarded by law or by a court to be, or declares itself to be, insolvent or unable to pay its debts as they fall due

children.name: text
children: f)

children.name: text
children: a petition is presented to appoint an examiner to the Specialist, or an order is made appointing an examiner to LLE

children.name: text
children: g)

children.name: text
children: the Specialist, being an individual, becomes bankrupt

children.name: text
children: h)

children.name: text
children: any event similar to the above insolvency events occurs in respect of the Specialist in any jurisdiction in which it is incorporated or has a place of business (12) the Specialist, if an individual, dies or becomes incapable of performing the Sub Contract

children.name: text
children: {b:11.2    Consequences of Insolvency of the Contractor}

children.name: text
children: 11.2.1   In the event that the Contractor becomes insolvent, LLE shall not be obliged to make any further payment to the Specialist of any sum which is due or may become due to the Specialist unless and until LLE has received payment in respect thereof from the Contractor and then only to the extent of such receipt and subject always to LLE's right to make deductions. The Contractor shall be deemed "insolvent" if any of the circumstances specified in s.3(6) of the Construction Contracts Act 2013 have occurred.

children.name: text
children: {b:11.3    Post Default Termination}

children.name: text
children: In the event of the Specialist's employment being terminated under clause 11.1, the following shall apply:

children.name: text
children: 11.3.1  Specialist shall leave the site in an orderly manner and remove any Specialist's Things

children.name: text
children: 11.3.2  The Specialist shall give LLE all Contract Documents and all Specialist's Documents

children.name: text
children: 11.3.3  The Specialist shall as soon as practicable provide to LLE a statement of the total of the following (the {b:termination sum}):-

children.name: text
children: 11.3.3.1The unpaid value of the Sub-Contract Works completed to the date of termination and valued in accordance with Clause 10.1 Payment Claims) hereof

children.name: text
children: 11.3.3.2The Specialist's reasonable costs of removal from the Site as a consequence of the termination all other amounts due to the Specialist under the Sub-Contract (but not damages)

children.name: text
children: {b:11.4 Termination at Specialist's Election}

children.name: text
children: 11.4.1LLE shall be entitled to terminate the Specialist's obligation to complete the Works at its election on 20 working days notice to the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: 11.4.2LLE may terminate the Specialist's obligation to complete the Works under this sub-clause 12.5 for the purpose of retaining another sub contractor to execute the Works, where, in the reasonable opinion of LLE, the circumstances justify taking such action.

children.name: text
children: 11.4.3LLE shall return any performance bond required under this Contract to LLE on termination under this sub-clause 12.5.

children.name: text
children: 11.4.4Not used

children.name: text
children: 11.4.5If the Specialist's obligation to complete the Works is terminated under sub-clause 12.4 or sub-clause 12.5 the following shall apply:

children.name: text
children: 11.4.5.1The Specialist shall leave the Site in an orderly manner and remove any Specialist's Things.

children.name: text
children: 11.4.5.2The Specialist shall give LLE all Works Requirements and all Specialists' Documents.
11.4.5.3The Specialist shall, as soon as practicable, give LLE a statement of the total of the following (the termination sum):

children.name: text
children: (1) the unpaid value of the parts of the Works completed to the date of termination in accordance with the Pricing Document, disregarding any provision limiting LLE's obligation to pay for partially completed work
(2) the Specialist's reasonable costs of removal from the Site as a consequence of the termination
(3) all other amounts due to the Specialist under the Contract but not damages.

children.name: text
children: 11.4.6 Within 10 working days of receiving this statement, LLE shall issue a certificate to the Specialist of the amount due from LLE to the Specialist or the Specialist to LLE, including the termination sum in the calculation of the amount due from LLE to the Specialist. If the certificate shows an amount owing to LLE, LLE shall issue an invoice to the Specialist for that amount, and LLE shall pay the amount due on the invoice within 15 working days after receiving the invoice. If the certificate shows an amount due to LLE, the Specialist shall pay the amount due within 10 working days of receiving LLE's demand for payment.

children: {b:12   DISPUTES}

children.name: text
children: 12.1 Method of Resolution

children.name: text
children: 12.1.1  Both parties have a statutory right under the Construction Contracts Act 2013 to refer a dispute relating to payment (a Payment Dispute) to adjudication at any time. Other disputes must be resolved in accordance with Sub-Clauses 12.3 to 12.6 below. The parties may agree to try to resolve Payment Disputes in accordance with Sub-Clauses 12.3 to 12.6 below instead of by reference to adjudication without affecting their statutory right to refer Payment Disputes to adjudication at any time.

children.name: text
children: 12.1.2  The Specialist is required to submit any notice of intention to refer any payment dispute for adjudication to the address specified in the Sub-Contract and to the persons named therein.

children.name: text
children: 12.2 Adjudication of Payment Disputes

children.name: text
children: 12.2.1    Either party may commence the adjudication of a Payment Dispute by serving on the other party at any time a notice of intention to refer the payment dispute to adjudication (a "Notice of Adjudication") to the address specified in the Sub-Contract and to the persons named therein.

children.name: text
children: 12.2.2 In the event of any disagreement regarding the rights and obligations of the parties under the Sub contract, the parties agree that they shall  use all reasonable endeavors to settle such disagreement amicably within 15 Working Days (or such other time period as may be agreed between the Parties, in writing) of the issuance of a notice of disagreement by either party.  Such notice shall call for a meeting of the respective senior managers of the Parties and the period of 15 Working Days shall be used to seek a resolution to the disagreement. The parties agree that there shall be no dispute, as required by the Construction Contracts Act, unless and until the foregoing process has adopted and the said 15 Working Days has expired.

children.name: text
children: If, following the above procedure, the parties have not reached a resolution, the provisions below will apply.

children.name: text
children: 12.2.3 Where either party serves a Notice of Adjudication, the parties shall attempt to agree to the appointment of an adjudicator who is competent to adjudicate the payment dispute in accordance with the Code of Practice published by the Minister for Jobs, Enterprise and Innovation.

children.name: text
children: 12.2.4 If the parties fail to appoint an adjudicator of their choice within 5 days of the serving of the Notice of Adjudication, either party may submit a written request to the Chair of the panel appointed by the Minister to appoint an adjudicator. This request shall be copied to the other party. The request shall include
(a) a copy of the Notice of Adjudication

children.name: text
children: a statement of when the Notice of Adjudication was served on the Responding Party and how this was done

children.name: text
children: any information which it is considered will assist the chair in appointing an adjudicator with the appropriate expertise to deal with a payment dispute.

children.name: text
children: 12.2.5 The adjudication shall be conducted in accordance with the Code of Practice published by the Minister. Within 7 days of the adjudicator's appointment the Referring Party shall refer the Payment Dispute to the Adjudicator. At the same time the referring party shall send a copy of the Referral and all accompanying documents to the other party. The date on which the referral is made is the start of the adjudication. The Adjudicator shall reach his decision within 28 days which he may extend to 42 days with the consent of the referring party or within such longer period as may be agreed by the parties.

children.name: text
children: 12.2.6 In the event that a Payment Dispute is referred to adjudication and the adjudicator's decision does not finally resolve the Payment Dispute either party is entitled to refer the payment dispute to arbitration in accordance with the sub-clause (f) below. The adjudicator's decision shall be binding until overturned by an arbitrator's award.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.3    Notice to Refer}

children.name: text
children: 12.3.1 If, the parties having failed to resolve a disagreement under clause 12.2.2, any dispute has thereby arisen between the parties in connection with or arising out of the Sub- Contract, either party may, by notice to the other, refer the dispute for arbitration by serving on the other a Notice to Refer. The Notice to Refer shall state the issues in dispute. The service of the Notice to Refer will be deemed to be the commencement of arbitration proceedings. Either party may within a period of 14 days of the Notice to Refer give notice to the other of further disputes and, if such notice is given, those further disputes will be deemed to be included in the reference to arbitration.

children.name: text
children: 12.3.2 If the Notice to Refer is served by the Specialist, and LLE is of the view that the issues in dispute relate in whole or in part to a dispute between LLE and the Contractor, provided LLE so indicates by notice to the Specialist in writing within 10 days of service of the Notice to Refer, the dispute, as between LLE and the Specialist in respect of those issues will be dealt with under sub-clause 12.5 hereof.

children.name: text
children: 12.3.3 Except to the extent that the disputes which are the subject matter of the Notice to Refer have been the subject of notice served by LLE under the preceding sub-clause 12.5.3 hereof, no step will be taken in the arbitration after the Notice to Refer has been served until the disputes have first been referred to conciliation.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.4    Conciliation}

children.name: text
children: 12.4.1 Except to the extent that the disputes which are the subject matter of the Notice to Refer have been the subject of notice served by LLE under the preceding sub-clause 12.5.3 hereof, no step will be taken in any arbitration after the Notice to Refer has been served until that dispute has first been referred to conciliation. Either party may initiate the conciliation process by seeking the appointment of a conciliator at any time after the expiry of 10 days from service of the Notice to Refer. During that period of 10 days either party may give notice to the other of further disputes and, if such notice is given, those further disputes will be deemed to be included in the reference to arbitration.

children.name: text
children: 12.4.2 The parties shall try to agree the appointment of a conciliator. If the parties are unable to agree a conciliator within 10 working days of the Notice to Refer, either party may apply to the President for the time being of the Construction Industry Federation who shall appoint a Conciliator. If there is a fee for making the appointment, the parties shall share it equally. Once a Conciliator has been appointed to a dispute between the parties, unless the parties agree otherwise, the same Conciliator shall deal with all other disputes between the parties, provided he/she is agreeable to do so.

children.name: text
children: If a party fails to comply with a conciliator's recommendation which is binding, the other party may take such court proceedings as are appropriate to force compliance with the conciliator's recommendation without availing further of the conciliation or arbitration processes.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.5 Joint Disputes}

children.name: text
children: Any disputes the subject matter of LLE's notice under sub-clause 12.5.3, hereof will be dealt with jointly with the dispute under the Main Contract on the following basis:-

children.name: text
children: LLE shall pursue the issue or issues in dispute under the Main Contract diligently

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall furnish LLE with all necessary information and documents in its possession in a timely manner and shall participate in and provide all necessary assistance for the preparation of submissions and pleadings and will indemnify LLE in respect of any loss or expense incurred as a result of the Specialist's failure to do so

children.name: text
children: LLE shall consult with the Specialist in regard to all pleadings and procedural matters in pursuing the dispute

children.name: text
children: LLE shall ensure that the views of the Specialist in relation to the disputes, and as they relate to the Sub-Contract, are transmitted to any appointed conciliator or arbitrator, will, as far as is practicable, safeguard the interests of the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall indemnify LLE in relation to any costs incurred in any such conciliation or arbitration to the extent that this is fair and reasonable having regard to the respective financial interests of the parties in relation to the issues in dispute and any provisions in the main contract or form of tender concerning the liability for the Contractor's costs and recovery of LLE's costs and all other relevant circumstances. The Specialist will make such payments on account as the conciliation or arbitration proceeds as are reasonably sought by LLE

children.name: text
children: LLE and the Specialist will be bound by the outcome of any such binding conciliation or arbitration between the Contractor and Specialist in so far as it relates to disputes connected with the Sub-Contract

children.name: text
children: {b:12.6 Arbitration}

children.name: text
children: Except in the case of a dispute to which Clause 12.5 hereof applies, the parties shall jointly appoint the arbitrator or, if the parties are unable to agree an arbitrator to be appointed under this clause, the arbitrator will be appointed by the President for the time being of the Construction Industry Federation. The appointment of a conciliator or arbitrator when Clause 12.3 applies will be made in accordance with the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: Any arbitration [other than under clause 12.5 hereof] between LLE and the Specialist will be governed by the Arbitration Procedure 2011 published by Engineers Ireland and will be subject to the Arbitration Act 2010.
