children: {b:13 Design}

children.name: text
children: {b:13.1 Design Provisions}

children.name: text
children: Insofar as it is stated in the Sub-Contract Particulars and or Appendix A(i) Pre-appointment Meeting; Description of the Sub-Contract Works or any portion thereof are to be designed in whole or in part by the Specialist, the following provisions shall apply:

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall, subject to the provisions of the Sub-Contract, complete the design for any part of the Sub-Contract Works for which design he is responsible, so as to ensure that its design of the Sub-Contract Works (or such relevant part of the Sub-Contract Works) is compatible with the design for the remainder of the Main Contract Works, and the Sub-Contract Works when completed in accordance with such design shall be fit for their intended purpose and in accordance with all requirements as set out in the Sub-Contract .. Where any part of the Sub-Contract Works has been designed by or on behalf of the Contractor under the Main Contract and/or LLE, the Specialist shall check such designs and accept responsibility for same including for any errors, omissions or discrepancies therein, first having obtained  the  approval  of  LLE  for  any  modifications  thereto  which  the  Specialist  may  consider necessary.  The  Specialist  shall  have  the  liability  for  any  designs  completed  or  produced  by  the Specialist, whether under statute or otherwise, to the same extent as an architect, engineer or other professional designer competent to undertake the design of the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall not use or specify for use in the Sub-Contract Works any materials or goods which by their nature application or use contravene any Technical Standards or Codes of Practice prevailing at the time of specification or use. The Sub-Contract Works shall comprise only new materials and goods suitable for the purpose of the Sub-Contract Works stated in or reasonably to be inferred from the Sub-Contract and where not so stated in or reasonably to be inferred, in accordance with current building practice including the relevant provisions of any Technical Standards and Codes of Practice prevailing at the time of the Sub-Contract Works. All such materials and goods are all or will be used in accordance with any relevant manufacturer's specifications.

children.name: text
children: {b:Design Indemnity}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall indemnify and hold harmless LLE against all claims under statute or common law for construction, trespass, nuisance or interference with any right of way, light air or water, made by the owners, occupiers, or users of any property adjoining the Site, that are a consequence of the designs prepared by or on behalf of the Specialist.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of the Sub-Contract, the Specialist shall not have or make any claim to LLE for an extension of time or for loss and/or expense either pursuant to the Sub-Contract or otherwise, where and to the extent that such delay or loss or expense is caused or contributed to by any failure by the Specialist to provide necessary drawings or documents in due time.

children.name: text
children: The Specialist shall forthwith after this Sub-Contract has been entered into, take out (unless he has already done so) and maintain a Professional Indemnity Insurance policy (with a well-established insurance office or underwriter of repute carrying on business in the United Kingdom / Ireland) with a limit of indemnity of the type, amount and duration as specified in the Sub-Contract. The Specialist shall as and when reasonably requested to do so by LLE, send to LLE documentary evidence that such insurance has been effected and is being maintained. If Professional Indemnity Insurance ceases to be available at commercially reasonable rates, the Specialist shall give immediate notice to LLE so that LLE and the Specialist can discuss and agree on the best means of protecting their respective interests.

children.name: text
children: {b:Design Responsibility}

children.name: text
children: The Specialist acknowledges that no acceptance, comment, approval and/or inspection of the Specialist's designs by LLE, in whole or in part, shall diminish or otherwise limit the Specialist's design responsibility under the Sub contract.
